headline: Samsung firmware update bricks smart fridges before holiday
summary: A faulty Samsung firmware update left many smart refrigerators stuck and non-functional just before a major South Korean holiday, spoiling food and frustrating owners. One affected user called the situation 'so absurd and embarrassing.'

claims.statement: A Samsung firmware update bricked smart refrigerators, leaving them stuck and non-functional
